label: preparing
what: A hospitality committee was coordinating a great-hall gathering, arranging a large bread provision (201 loaves) for committee hospitality. The innkeeper, freight, and builder are explicitly named as the committee. Baker supplied/baked bread and exchanged wheat for builder's spare planks and lanterns; neighbour offered help with baking and is knowingly involved in the broader mutual-help preparations, though not established as a committee member. The mayor was not told the arrangement's purpose until day 1 and was not informed about the planning beforehand.
